 1 / 7 From becoming a child actress at a young age to major controversies and struggles: A look at Bigg Boss 20 fame Arishfa Khan’s journey
 Arishfa Khan’s journey from a child actress to a social media sensation and now a Bigg Boss 20 contestant has won many hearts. She is reportedly the second-youngest contestant after Yung DSA. While viewers are getting to see her competitive side, Arishfa has often spoken about taking care of her household and the responsibilities she carries beyond the cameras. Here's a look at her journey:-
 (Photos from: Instagram)
 2 / 7 From a child actress to a familiar television face
 Arishfa entered the entertainment industry at a young age and made her acting debut with Chhal, Sheh Aur Maat in 2012. She went on to appear in shows such as Ek Veer Ki Ardaas…Veera, Jeannie Aur Juju and Uttaran, gradually becoming a familiar face among television audiences. Long before reality television, she had already spent years learning the demands of working in front of the camera.
 3 / 7 Navigating showbiz and education
 Arishfa's childhood was challenging as she attempted to balance her professional career with her academics. Apart from joining the show Papa By Chance as the lead character, Arishfa faced other difficulties in her life. In particular, the COVID-19 lockdown forced her to study from home. She later gained major fame through her Tik Tok videos.
 4 / 7 Mother’s sacrifice and support
 Arishfa's mother has been her greatest supporter throughout her career. Her mother's transition from being a stuntswoman to a supportive parent who follows her career everywhere has kept Arishfa grounded. Arishfa has acknowledged her mother's tremendous sacrifices that enabled her to pursue a career in the film industry.
 5 / 7 Danish Zehen tragedy
 Arishfa faced a significant challenge following the 2018 demise of her close friend Danish Zehen. Her reaction to the tragic incident, including posting heartfelt messages on social media, triggered many. In particular, Arishfa's response to the tragedy appeared to indicate that she was in a relationship with Danish. Arishfa strongly denied the allegations and described Danish as someone like a brother to her.
 6 / 7 From digital media sensation to music videos
 Arishfa's fame continued to grow as she starred in video formats such as Yaara 2. Besides her television and social media career, Arishfa has been a sensation in the fashion, beauty, and lifestyle industry. As of now, the young star has more than 29 million Instagram followers.
 7 / 7 Managing the house and career
 At only six years old, she had entered the showbiz industry and has been balancing her career with her parental duties. Currently, she is in the middle of one of her most significant challenges in the reality show. Arishfa's journey from a child star to a social media sensation and a reality TV star has been admired and loved by her fans.
